item.title: Scott Air Force Base suspends Trusted Traveler Program after Iran strikes
item.description: Following the United States' and Israel's attack of Iran over the weekend, Scott Air Force Base has announced the "immediate suspension" of its Trusted Traveler Program.

item.title: Officials in small Missouri city awarded themselves improper bonuses: Audit
item.description: Officials in a small Missouri city awarded themselves improper bonuses using federal pandemic relief funds, according to a report from the Missouri State Auditor.

item.title: Following $241M verdict in dry ice death case, attorneys say insurers are next
item.description: The verdict followed an eight-day trial that ended with about one hour of jury deliberation.

item.title: 6 troops dead in Iran operation, US military says in update
item.description: The death toll among U.S. service members has risen, the military says.

item.title: St. Louis mayor pushes back against bill shifting police liability costs to city
item.description: St. Louis Mayor Cara Spencer took her issues with state control of the city's police department to the Missouri Capitol on Monday.

item.title: Thief steals $10,000 in tools from Fenton man's truck
item.description: Ben Hurst spent years amassing a collection of plumbing tools. On Saturday, Hurst was working in his yard before noon. He walked around to the back of his house and when he came back, all of it had been stolen.

item.title: Students and friends celebrate life of skating coach killed in Starbucks shooting
item.description: Friends, family, coaches, and students gathered Monday afternoon in Webster Groves to honor the life of 28-year-old figure skating coach Sam Linehan.

item.title: Arts community mourns teen performer killed in Belleville shooting
item.description: A tragic shooting in Belleville over the weekend is sending shockwaves through the region’s arts community. A young performer known for his talent and bright spirit is being remembered tonight by those who watched him grow on stage.

item.title: Manhunt underway for suspect in Lake St. Louis killing
item.description: A St. Charles, Missouri, man is on the run after police say he gunned down another man in Lake St. Louis over the weekend.

item.title: Alleged masked rapist nabbed with family DNA and relentless police work
item.description: Search warrants obtained by FOX 2 reveal the unusual way police captured a reported kidnapper/rapist who seemingly left few leads.
